summary: Confirmed both requested embedding-ablation estimates against PDF pp. 7, 11, and 12, with design and classifier-method checks on pp. 3, 4, and 10. Read the complete markdown conversion, including references and Appendices A-C. The printed counts of 65 AI participants and 118 participants overall describe the essay corpus used by the ablation analyses. The pooled control participant count and total ablation score count are not printed and correctly remain null. Figure 8(a)-(b) reports classifier accuracy and F1 across embedding sizes only as curves; the null numerical statistics are appropriate. Visual inspection confirms shaded variability bands in both panels. Repeated cross-validation and embedding-coordinate sampling produce scores on sets of essays, supporting unit=set and se_basis=set; the band type and numerical uncertainty are unspecified. The across_people, diversity, automated_score, more_diverse, immediate, outcome_with_ai=true, within_person=null, and ai_vs_bau codes match the paper and codebook. No additional eligible full-sample outcome or contrast was found missing under extraction-spec rules 4-6.
